items.title: Costco Wholesale (COST) Could Be 15% Undervalued After Fresh August Sales Figures
items.summary: Costco Wholesale (COST) just reported fresh sales figures, giving you a new data point on how this warehouse giant is performing ahead of its upcoming quarterly earnings release later in September. Despite Costco Wholesale reporting double digit sales growth for August and the fiscal year, the share price has eased lately. The 7 day share price return is 3.1% and the 90 day share price return is 5.8%, compared with a year to date gain of 7.2%. Contrast Costco Wholesale's recent sales momentum...
